description: This file defines the interface for a semaphore implementation in C, including creation, destruction, posting, waiting, and retrieving the semaphore's value, along with documentation comments for each function.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Create
methods.description: Creates an unnamed semaphore with initial value 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Post
methods.description: Increments the semaphore value by 1 and wakes waiting threads.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the semaphore.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Wait
methods.description: Waits until the semaphore value is greater than 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_TimedWait
methods.description: Waits for the semaphore until the specified timeout or the semaphore becomes available.

calls: rtError rtSemaphore_TimedWait(rtSemaphore sem, struct timespec* t)
